title: fix: preserve manually-entered best/worst laps when adding lap rows
body:
## Summary

PR #22's fix only handled the empty-laps case (early return when `validLaps.length === 0`). The user's actual flow — enter best/worst manually, then add laps and type times into them — still triggered `syncSummary` which overwrote the manual entries with computed values.

Fix: a `manualLapTimes` ref tracks whether the user typed into the best/worst fields directly. `syncSummary` now preserves those fields when the ref is set, only overwriting lap-computed values for fields the user hasn't manually entered. The ref resets on form open/close/submit. `avgLap` always recalculates since it's derived.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/e8416ddf4add4559914b0965c29d237d
Requested by: @Litle-Drip
